name: Dwarf Fortress (Legacy)
description:
Dwarf Fortress (Legacy) is the classic, acclaimed ASCII-based fantasy world simulation and fortress management game by Bay 12 Games. It procedurally generates an intricate world complete with geology, mythology, history, and civilizations.

Features:
- Complete fortress management simulation with complex economics, engineering, and sociology
- Adventure mode allowing exploration of the procedurally generated historical world
- Authentic classic ASCII interface with support for community tilesets
- Unmatched procedural depth with detailed body anatomy, combat, and fluids physics
- Deep, living sandbox universe where every creature and civilization leaves historical records
